review_candidates.title: Senior Network & Systems Administrator
review_candidates.description_excerpt: SSS is looking for a Senior Network & Systems Administrator to own our network, cloud and Microsoft 365 infrastructure. Key Responsibilities Own the design, implementation and optimization of the enterprise network: LAN/WAN, VLANs, routing (OSPF, BGP, static), Layer 2/3 switching and multi-site connectivity (site-to-site VPN, SD-WAN). Architect and administer Microsoft Azure and AWS environments: VMs, virtual networks (VNets, NSGs, route tables), Private Endpoints and Private DNS zones, storage,
eligibility_evidence: It is offshore-based, serving Samir Group (KSA), and works full-time on-site from our Heliopolis office.
Own Microsoft Entra ID, Exchange (Online and On-Premises) and Microsoft 365 administration, including hybrid identity through Entra Connect (sync, writeback, Hybrid Join) and hybrid Exchange.
Proven experience administering Exchange (hybrid), Microsoft 365 and Intune (Autopilot, compliance policies) in enterprise environments, including Conditional Access and PIM.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Requirements Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science or a related field. 5+ years of experience in network and systems administration. Deep hands-on expertise in routing (OSPF, BGP), switching, VLANs and LAN/WAN design. Hands-on experience with enterprise firewalls (Fortinet, Palo Alto, Cisco or similar), public DNS, Cloudflare/WAF and SSL/TLS certificates.
